meta.title: Azure Cloud Sword Immortal
meta.description: Azure Cloud Sword Immortal — a white-haired, black-and-gold sword immortal in the bottom-right corner. 23 standing poses plus a 16-frame sword dance, 14 talisman skins and 10 switchable sounds. He watches your balance and keeps the ledger: the Ledger tab shows today / last 7 days / all time with per-model share and searchable per-turn details; the Notice tab covers low balance, per-turn cost, question and approval alerts, a daily budget, the late-night nudge and wellness reminders. Bubbles play as a click sequence and can be edited visually from More (rows / modules / styles / saved lines). Five quick clicks fly the sword around the screen for one lap (also a More entry). Config writes are accepted only from this machine (x-xjj-write header required); every asset is inlined and no tokens are spent.
